data.professional_title: BUSINESS ANALYST | QA MANAGER | BFSI PAYMENTS
data.summary: Technical Business Analyst with 13+ years of experience (7+ years as a Business Analyst) in Banking and Financial Services (BFSI), specializing in Digital Banking, Payments, API Integration, Technical Solutioning, Requirement Engineering, Agile Delivery, and Stakeholder Management. Experienced in translating business requirements into technical specifications, API documentation, process flows, and solution designs while collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver enterprise banking solutions.

responsibilities: Partnered with Product Owners to refine and prioritize the product backlog, ensuring alignment with business objectives and sprint goals.
Translated business requirements into Epics, User Stories, and Tasks in JIRA to support Agile delivery.

Collaborated with business stakeholders, architects, and engineering teams to gather business requirements, define API integration requirements, document functional specifications, and support end-to-end solution delivery across banking applications.

Collaborated with business and technology teams to gather and document requirements for SWIFT payment processing, including MT/MX message formats, payment workflows, exception handling, and integration with core banking and payment systems.
Knowledge of AWS Cloud and cloud-based application architecture, with an understanding of cloud integration, APIs, data flows, deployment, and application delivery.
Authored BRDs, FRDs, User Stories, API specifications, process flows, sequence diagrams, and data mapping documents to support integration between upstream and downstream banking systems.
Performed SQL-based data validation and analysis to support requirement verification, production investigations, and business reporting.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to define exception handling, audit requirements, and integration workflows for banking transaction processing.
Conducted gap analysis, feasibility studies, and impact assessments to support informed business and technical decision-making.
Facilitated Agile ceremonies, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
Led UAT planning and execution by preparing test scenarios, coordinating with stakeholders, and supporting defect resolution during testing cycles.
Coordinated with developers, QA teams, Product Owners, and business stakeholders to ensure seamless solution delivery and successful production releases.
Analyzed business and transaction data, prepared dashboards and reports, and provided insights to support business decisions.
Worked with engineering teams to analyze event-driven integrations using Kafka topics for real-time transaction processing and data exchange between banking applications.
Identified process improvement opportunities by redesigning workflows, eliminating bottlenecks, and recommending automation initiatives.
Delivered Business Analysis support for global banking clients, including AMEX, CAX, FTB, ANZ, and SMBC, supporting digital banking and payment solutions.
Directed the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) across requirements analysis, testing, and implementation to ensure successful software delivery.
Delivered multiple releases for MBP Core Banking Systems, ensuring application stability and reliability for global banking clients.
Implemented and validated PROFILE Core Banking modules across multiple deployments, ensuring application quality and production readiness.
Performed comprehensive manual testing, including functional, regression, integration, and system testing, while implementing defect prevention strategies.
Optimized Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) processes to improve testing efficiency and streamline defect management.
Developed test plans, test cases, traceability matrices, and test execution reports to ensure comprehensive requirement coverage.
Led defect triage meetings and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) sessions, collaborating with development teams to resolve issues and prevent defect recurrence.
Supported production deployments, application performance monitoring, and post-production validation for MBP Core Banking Systems.
Collaborated with business analysts, developers, and product teams to align quality assurance activities with business requirements and product objectives.
Validated production readiness by performing release verification, regression testing, and deployment support across global implementations.
